items.title: Air New Zealand’s Tech-Savvy CEO on AI and the Limits of the Machine
items.summary: An AI-powered airline is a fine ambition – but it won't touch the fuel price, the grounded engines, or the weak Kiwi dollar doing the real damage. Ravishankar's edge is that he seems to know it.

items.title: The Best Luxury Experiences Leave Some Slack in the System
items.summary: The marketing from luxury's top brands has blurred into one seamless, forgettable product. The operators pulling away are the ones who figured out that friction is the point.

items.title: UK and Australia Lift Gulf Travel Warnings, But European Airlines Await Clearance

items.title: JTB Is Expanding Out of Japan. EXO Travel Is the Latest Deal

items.title: AI Isn’t Ignoring Airlines. It Just Can’t Read Their Fares.
